questions.question: ‘Slash and burn’ type of farming is also known as:
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Shif**ting farming__.

__
 
• **Shifting farming**__ also called as Slash and burn’ type of farming.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Shifting farming**

__
 
• Farmers clear a patch of land and produce crops to sustain their families.
 
• When soil fertility decreases, the farmers shift and start cultivating in the same way on a fresh patch of land.
 
• This allows nature to replenish the fertility of the soil.
 
• Productivity in this type of farming is low as fertilizers or modern inputs are not used.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**Intensive subsistence farming**

 
• This type of farming is practiced in areas of high population pressure on land.
 
• It is done where high doses of biochemical inputs and irrigation are used for obtaining higher production.

**Commercial farming**

 
• The main characteristic of this type of farming is the use of higher doses of modern inputs e.g., high yielding variety (HYV) seeds, chemical fertilizers, insecticides, and pesticides in order to obtain productivity.
 
• The degree of commercialization varies from region to region.

questions.question: The first major nation wide Satyagraha launched by Mahatma Gandhi was against:
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is **Rowlatt Act.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• This Rowlatt act was passed on the recommendations of the** Sedition Committee chaired by Sir Sidney Rowlatt.**
 
• This act had been hurriedly passed in the Imperial Legislative Council despite the united opposition of the Indian members.
 
• It gave the government enormous powers to repress political activities and allowed the detention of political prisoners without trial for two years.
 
• **Mahatma Gandh**i wanted non-violent civil disobedience against such unjust laws, which would start with a hartal on 6 April 1919.
 
• Gandhiji called for a countrywide Satyagraha campaign against the Rowlatt Act.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Partition of Bengal**

 
• The decision to split Bengal came in **July 1905.**
 
• The decision had come after Lord Curzon claimed that Bengal was too large to be governed effectively.
 
• The partition separated the largely Muslim eastern areas from the largely Hindu western areas.

**Salt Tax**

 
• Britain's** Salt Act of 1882 **prohibited Indians from collecting or selling salt, a staple in their diet.
 
• Indian citizens were forced to buy the vital mineral from their British rulers, who, in addition to exercising a monopoly over the manufacture and sale of salt, also charged a heavy salt tax.

questions.question: The Government of India releases MSP of agricultural produce from time to time. What is the full form of MSP?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Minimum Support Price.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Minimum Support Price**

__
 
• Minimum Support Price (MSP) is a form of market intervention by the Government of India to insure agricultural producers against any sharp fall in farm prices.
 
• The minimum support prices are announced by the Government of India at the beginning of the sowing season for certain crops.
 
• The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs, chaired by Prime Minister approves the **Minimum Support Price (MSP)** based on recommendations of the **Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP). **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• As of now, CACP recommends MSPs of 23 commodities, which comprise-
 
 
• 7 cereals (paddy, wheat, maize, sorghum, pearl millet, barley and ragi)
 
• 5 pulses (gram, tur, moong, urad, lentil)
 
• 7 oilseeds (groundnut, rapeseed-mustard, soyabean, seasmum, sunflower, safflower, nigerseed)
 
• 4 commercial crops (copra, sugarcane, cotton and raw jute)
 
 
 
• CACP submits its recommendations to the government in the form of Price Policy Reports every year, separately for five groups of commodities namely Kharif crops, Rabi crops, Sugarcane, Raw Jute and Copra.

questions.question: Dry Ice is the solid form of:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Carbon Dioxide**__.

__
 
• **Dry ice is the solid form of carbon dioxide**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] __Important Points__**

__
 
• **Uses of Dry Ice:**

 
 
• It is used primarily as a** cooling agent** but is also used in fog machines at theatres for dramatic effects.
 
• It does not leave any residue other than incidental frost from moisture in the atmosphere.
 
• It is useful for preserving frozen foods where mechanical cooling is unavailable.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Methane**

 
 
• Methane is a chemical compound with the chemical formula CH₄.
 
• It is a colourless, odourless gas that occurs abundantly in nature and as a product of certain human activities.
 
• Methane is a powerful greenhouse gas.
 
• Methane is flammable and is used as fuel worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Oxygen**
 
 
• Oxygen is a colourless, odourless, tasteless gas essential for living organisms.
 
• Common uses of oxygen include production of steel, plastics, and textiles, brazing, welding and cutting of steel and other metals, rocket propellant, oxygen therapy, and life support systems in aircraft, submarines, spaceflight, and diving.
 
 
 
• **Ozone**
 
 
• Ozone is a pale blue gas with a distinctively pungent smell.
 
• Ozone (O₃) is a highly reactive gas composed of three oxygen atoms.
 
• It is both a natural and a man-made product that occurs in the Earth's upper atmosphere.
 
• Most ozone (about 90%) is found in the **stratosphere**.

questions.question: Golconda Fort was built in the 13th century by the _______ Dynasty
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is__** Kakatiya Dynasty.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Golconda Fort is located in **Hyderabad, **Telangana, 
 
• The fort was built by the** Kakatiya dynasty in the 13th century.**
 
• Golconda fort owes much of its present grandeur to Mohammad Quli Qutub Shah.
 
• Golconda flourished as a trade center of large diamonds, known as the Golconda Diamonds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**The Kakatiya dynasty **

 
• The Kakatiya dynasty was a South Indian dynasty that ruled between the 12th and 14th centuries.
 
• Their area included most of the eastern Deccan region comprising present-day Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, and parts of eastern Karnataka and southern Odisha 
 
• Their capital was **Orugallu**, now known as Warangal.

**The Chola Empire **

 
• The Chola Empire was founded by **Vijayalaya. **
 
• He took over the Tanjore kingdom in the 8th century and led to the rise of the mighty Cholas by defeating the Pallavas.
 
• **The Brihadisvara temple, the Gangaikondacholisvaram, and the Airavatesvara temples** were built during their reign.

**The Chalukya dynasty**

 
• The Chalukya dynasty ruled large parts of southern and central India between the 6th and the 12th centuries.
 
• The Chalukyas who ruled from Badami were the Western Chalukyas.
 
• The ones who ruled from Kalyani are referred to as **Later Western Chalukyas **and the **Chalukyas of Vengi** are known to historians as the Eastern Chalukya.

questions.question: The economic survey is usually presented _______ before the Union Budget.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**1 day.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Economic Survey is presented in both the houses of Parliament, **a day before the announcement of the Union Budget.**
 
• The Economic Survey is prepared under the guidance of the **Chief Economic Advisor. **

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• The Economic Survey contains detailed information about the Indian economy over the past year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first Economic Survey was presented in the year **1950-51.**
 
• Until 1964, it was presented along with the Union Budget, but later it was disjointed from the Union Budget to give a better understanding of the budget proposals.

questions.question: Gita Gopinath became the first woman to occupy the position of Chief Economist of:
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**International Monetary Fund.**__

__
 
• **Gita Gopinath **has been appointed chief economist of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in **2019.**
 
• She became the first woman to hold the position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Gita Gopinath is an American economist who has been the **Chief Economist of the International Monetary Fund **since 2019.
 
• In that role, she is the Director of the IMF's Research Department and the Economic Counsellor of the Fund.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**WTO**

 
• The World Trade Organization (WTO) is the only global international organization dealing with the rules of trade between nations.
 
• The WTO has 164 members (including European Union) and 23 observer governments (like Iran, Iraq, Bhutan, Libya etc).

**UNESCO**

 
• The United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organization is a specialised agency of the United Nations aimed at promoting world peace and security through international cooperation in education, sciences, and culture.
 
• The Organization has 193 Members and 11 Associate Members.
 
• **The United States and Israel** left on 31 December 2018 asserting that the organization had an anti-Israel bias.

**World Bank**

 
• The World Bank is an international financial institution that provides loans and grants to the governments of low and middle-income countries for the purpose of pursuing capital projects. 

**International Monetary Fund**

 
• The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is an organization of 190 countries.
 
• It works to foster global monetary cooperation, secure financial stability, facilitate international trade, promote high employment and sustainable economic growth, and reduce poverty around the world.

questions.question: A special property of acids and bases is their ability to _______ each other’s properties.

__
 
• The reaction between an acid and a base to form salt and water is called a **neutralization reaction**.
 
• That is: **Acid + Base → Salt + Water**
 
• The examples of neutralization reactions are as follows :
 
 
• Sodium hydroxide reacts with sulphuric acid to form sodium sulfate and water :
 
• 2NaOH (aq) + H₂SO₄ (aq) → Na₂SO₄ (aq) + 2H₂O (l)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Crystallization** is defined as a process by which a chemical is converted from a liquid solution into a solid crystalline state.

questions.question: Timur invaded India during whose reign?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is** ​**__**Nasir-ud-Din Mahmud Shah Tughluq.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nasir-ud-Din Mahmud Shah Tughluq** was the last sultan of the Tughlaq dynasty.
 
• It was during the reign of him Timur invaded India in 1398 A.D.
 
• He crossed Indus and captured Multan, and just walked over to Delhi without much resistance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**Akbar**

 
• Akbar was the third Mughal emperor, who reigned from 1556 to 1605.
 
• Akbar was crowned at the age of fourteen.
 
• Akbar succeeded his father, Humayun, under a regent, Bairam Khan, who helped the young emperor expand and consolidate Mughal domains in India.

**Alauddin Khilji**

 
• Ala-ud-din Khalji ruled from **1296–1316.**
 
• Alauddin was a nephew and a son-in-law of his predecessor Jalaluddin.
 
• Ala-ud-din was the first Sultan to pay his soldiers in cash rather than give them a share of the booty.

**Feroz Shah Tughlaq**

 
• Sultan Firoz Shah Tughlaq was a Muslim ruler of the Tughlaq dynasty, who reigned over the Sultanate of Delhi from 1351 to 1388.
 
• He established Sharia across his realm.

questions.question: In the context of climate, what is the full form of ITCZ?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Inter-Tropical Convergence Zone**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Intertropical Convergence Zone, or ITCZ, is **the region that circles the Earth, near the equator.**
 
• Here the trade winds of the Northern and Southern hemispheres come together.
 
• The intense sun and warm water of the equator heats the air in the ITCZ, raising its humidity and making it buoyant.
 
• With the help of convergence of the trade winds, the buoyant air rises.
 
• As the air rises it expands and cools, releasing the accumulated moisture in an almost perpetual series of thunderstorms.
